The '''Galactic Corporate Policy League (GCPL)''', or the '''Corporate Policy League''', was a pro-[[Militarists/Legends|militant]] and pro-business lobbyist group operating in the final [[Standard century/Legends|century]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], aiming to influence [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] policy to those ends. Overall, however, the group was not popular among the Senate<ref name="Darth Plagueis">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref> in [[32 BBY]].<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], who was active in the Senate under his guise as Senator Palpatine of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], compared embracing the CPL at that time to someone being in open support of [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]].<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />

In the 32 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]<ref name="TERC" /> [[Supreme Chancellor election, 32 BBY/Legends|Supreme Chancellor election]], the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] and CPL endorsed [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Ainlee Teem/Legends|Ainlee Teem]] in his campaign for [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]]. However, the CPL's endorsement essentially doomed his chances of securing the election as the Senate, already unwilling to elect a militant Gran, did not wish to support someone backed by the CPL. In the end, it was Palpatine who won the election, paving [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] closer to the [[Order of the Sith Lords|Sith Order]]'s planned [[Clone Wars/Legends|galactic war]] and the [[Declaration of a New Order|culmination]] of its [[Grand Plan/Legends|Grand Plan]].<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />

==Behind the scenes==
The sourcebook that detailed the league stated that it supported Palpatine's bid for "Presidency;" petitioned him to limit government economic controls; and were made "founding" members of the CSA. All of these seem to be in conflict with later information from the [[Prequel trilogy|Prequel]] era; Palpatine's election to [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] was too sudden to include outside campaigning. Additionally, sources refer to the CSA as early as 26-27 BBY, at least eight years before it was formed from the GCPL.
